description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan due date calculations in the Apache Fineract project. It subclasses BaseLoanIntegrationTest and defines multiple parameterized test methods to verify repayment schedule generation based on different start date configurations and disbursement scenarios.

classes.name: LoanDueCalculationTest
classes.description: A test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest that contains parameterized tests for verifying due date calculations for loans under various configurations.

methods.name: processingStrategy
methods.description: Provides different loan processing strategies for parameterized tests.

methods.name: dueDateBasedOnFirstRepaymentDate
methods.description: Tests repayment schedule calculation when due dates are based on the first repayment date.

methods.name: dueDateBasedOnExpectedDisbursementDate
methods.description: Tests due date calculation based on expected disbursement date configuration.

methods.name: dueDateBasedOnSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Verifies repayment schedule when due dates are calculated from the submitted on date.

methods.name: dueDateBasedOnSubmittedOnDateButThereShallBeMinimumDaysBetweenDisbursementAndFirstRepayment
methods.description: Tests the minimum days enforcement between disbursement and first repayment date.

methods.name: dueDateBasedOnExpectedDisbursalDateButThereShallBeMinimumDaysBetweenDisbursementAndFirstRepayment
methods.description: Verifies schedule adjustments when a minimum days gap is required between disbursement and first repayment based on disbursal date.
